digest.component_or_area: rebar binding store and Jira reconciliation
propositions: Jira issues moved between projects change their KEY but retain immutable numeric ID; bindings keyed on the mutable KEY can silently detach when the old key stops resolving due to missing `moved_issue_key` table updates by third-party movers.
The absence probe incorrectly retires live issues as orphaned when their old KEY 404s, even though the issue remains accessible by its numeric ID.

Bindings must record and persist the numeric `jira_id` alongside the `jira_key`, and retry by ID on key lookup failure, re-keying to the current key and updating the reverse index when the ID resolves to a different key.
The fix is additive (preserving all existing key-keyed paths and Cloud behavior) and safe on pre-existing stores without recorded IDs, with no migration required.

On a real Jira Data Center 8.17.1, GET /rest/api/2/issue/{oldKey} after a project key rename returns 200 with the new key in the body, confirming that stale keys persist through `moved_issue_key` until third-party movers fail to update that table.
